external_inputs.name: Evertse-Schlickewei-Schmidt, Theorem 1.1
external_inputs.scope: Finiteness of nondegenerate unit-equation solutions in a finite-rank multiplicative group. Used in the written bounded-template two-arm theorem, not in Lean.

external_inputs.name: Dobrowolski, Acta Arithmetica 34 (1979), 391–401
external_inputs.scope: Mahler-measure lower bound for noncyclotomic irreducible algebraic integers, used to bound the number of factors. Not formalized here.

external_inputs.name: Voutier, An effective lower bound for the height of algebraic numbers, Acta Arithmetica 74 (1996), 81–95
external_inputs.scope: Independent primary confirmation of the Mahler-measure bound used in the written cycle factor count; no complete proof replay.

external_inputs.name: Wu-Wang, Theorem 1
external_inputs.scope: Homogeneous specialization of a lower bound on a linear form in 1, log 2, log 3. Used for cycle determinant growth and the all-depth trace discrepancy exponent. Not formalized here.

external_inputs.name: Bařina, Improved verification limit for the convergence of the Collatz conjecture
external_inputs.scope: External exhaustive convergence coverage through 2^71. Only needed in round twelve to apply the high-path equality to all hypothetical nonperiodic orbits; neither the finite-class nor bounded-lag finiteness theorem depends on this external coverage. Full computation not replayed.

external_inputs.name: Weaver-Wren, paper 48, page labelled v2, Lemma 7 (76) and Theorem 8 (82)–(83)
external_inputs.scope: Uniform fixed-total inverse-word floor with bounded real carry and linear ternary extra depth. New trace lower implications remain conditional on this input; source quantifiers were checked but its full analytic proof and supporting chain were not independently certified or formalized.

external_inputs.name: Corvaja-Zannier, A lower bound for the height of a rational function at S-unit points
external_inputs.scope: The fixed-S gcd comparison motivated the new elementary short-relation resultant argument. The resulting bound does not invoke this theorem.

external_inputs.name: Chudnovsky, November 2026 preprint, Corollary 1.2
external_inputs.status: optional reported preprint input, not used in main conclusions
external_inputs.scope: The trace note records a conditional sharpening if its reported homogeneous logarithmic-form estimate is assumed. No external formalization or proof replay; neither the main cofinal nor the published Wu-Wang trace conclusion needs it.
